answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 50783 Country: India Title: To tie a black thread around an arm or ankle or wrist is kind of shirk or not? Question: Is it shirk to tie a black thread around an ankle, arm or wrist and also will the fardh namaz or any namaz performed by having it tied will be valid or invalid? Note: Black thread being tied so as protection from an evil-eye, black magic etc. Answer ID: 50783 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 399/419/N=04/1435) (1) If the person who ties black thread around ankle, arm, wrist or waist does not consider it effective in itself as well as no other shirkiya or kufriya belief is attached to it, then it may not be called shirk, but it is unlawful to tie it. (2) If someone offers fardh or nafl salah tying black thread then his salah shall be valid, but makrooh. (3) In order to avoid evil eyes, black magic etc one should do any lawful act and for the same one should consult any reliable and authentic Amil. It is not correct to contact any non-Muslim or unauthentic Amil. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
